podcast.body: A song from the "Underdogs" album. Its music video, directed by Bill Morrison, was filmed in a TD building in Vancouver over two nights, an alternative plan after an initial concept to shoot in Mexico during Cinco de Mayo was canceled. Despite the record company's initial negative reaction, calling the video "suicide," it was delivered to MuchMusic and played a crucial role in boosting album sales from around 20,000 to over 100,000 units. "And then operations kind of broke down with the video that song, Me and Bill Morrison."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
